The prompt mode. Valid values: `Template` (template mode) and `PE` (advanced PE mode).

If this parameter is omitted, you must provide the `Prompt` parameter. We recommend that the prompt includes the topic, length, requirements, and prohibitions.

If `PromptMode` is set to `Template`, you must provide `WritingParams`, which is a dictionary of string key-value pairs. For the required schema, see the `.Data.TemplateDefine[].Fields` field in the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2922609.html operation.

`topic`: Required. The topic to write about.

`prompt`: Optional. Any additional custom prompts or writing requirements

Event.description_en:
The type of event. The service returns two types of events: writing events and other events.

The writing event, `task-progress-start-generating`, indicates that the output contains the complete article information.

Other events, such as `writing-instruction-analysis` (instruction analysis), `task-progress-news-search-end` (web search), and `result-intent-recognition-end` (intent recognition), can be monitored through the `payload.output.text` field or ignored

The step for step-by-step writing. Valid values:

`OutlineGenerate`: Outline generation

`Writing`: Article writing

When `DistributeWriting` is `true`, the default flow for step-by-step writing is to first generate an outline and then write the content based on it
v1_body_parameters.help_zh:
分步骤写作步骤：
OutlineGenerate:  大纲生成
Writing:  写作

在分步骤写作场景中（DistributeWriting=true） 默认 先写大纲、后根据大纲写作
v1_body_parameters.name: Step

v1_body_parameters.help_en: A list of summarization objects, used for step-by-step writing
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 摘编对象列表（分步骤接口使用）
v1_body_parameters.name: Summarization

v1_body_parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the task. You can reuse the same task ID for a multi-turn conversation.

The system automatically generates a `TaskId` if you do not specify one. Reusing the same `TaskId` for subsequent requests groups them into a single conversation
v1_body_parameters.help_zh:
任务唯一ID，多轮对话可复用同一轮任务ID

TaskId默认无需填写，系统将自动生成。当后续任务填写的TaskId相同时，表示这些任务属于同一组对话
v1_body_parameters.name: TaskId

v1_body_parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable web search. If `true`, the system uses its built-in web search feature. Default: `false`
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 是否使用联网检索。（默认不检索，true 则会 走 系统自带的 联网检索）
v1_body_parameters.name: UseSearch

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the Model Studio workspace. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识：获取https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
v1_body_parameters.name: WorkspaceId

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The parameters for template-based writing, provided as a dictionary of string key-value pairs. You must provide either `Prompt` or `WritingParams`. For more information, see the description of the `PromptMode` parameter
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 模板写作参数（字典结构，key value 都是字符串）（prompt 和 writingParams 二选一，详情请参考PromptMode字段说明）
v1_body_parameters.name: WritingParams

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The writing scene. Valid values: `government` (government affairs), `media`, `market` (marketing), `office`, and `custom`
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 写作场景（government:政务、media:传媒、market:营销，office：办公,custom:自定义）
v1_body_parameters.name: WritingScene

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The writing style. For a list of supported styles, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2922609.html
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 写作文体，具体文体列表请参考：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2922609.html
v1_body_parameters.name: WritingStyle
